strategies.label: Not specified
strategies.description: Do not use a reaction-mechanism condition prior.

strategies.label: Transition-metal catalysis
strategies.description: Favor structurally supported C–C and C–heteroatom coupling pathways with leaving-group departure.

strategies.label: Metal-free polar chemistry
strategies.description: Slightly de-emphasize classic cross-coupling patterns without excluding SNAr or substitution pathways.

strategies.label: Radical conditions
strategies.description: Record a radical-mechanism hypothesis without inventing selectivity from structure alone.

strategies.label: Photochemical
strategies.description: Record light-driven conditions; structural ranking changes only when supported by explicit rules.

strategies.label: Thermal / uncatalyzed
strategies.description: Record thermal conditions without assuming a named mechanism.
